question: 我在屹通新材涨价前买了100股，在它今天最高价的时候卖出，然后在现在又继续买入50股，假如买入不收取手续费，卖出的手续费需要收取百分之10%，那么我总共花多少钱？

steps.description: Locate the text showing the initial number of shares purchased
Locate the reference price value in the image
Locate the price adjustment value in the image
Calculate the initial buy price by adding the reference price and price adjustment
Calculate the initial total cost by multiplying initial shares by initial buy price
Locate the highest sell price value in the image
Calculate the total sell price by multiplying initial shares by highest sell price
Locate the fee rate percentage for selling
Calculate the selling fee by multiplying sell total price by fee rate
Calculate the net sell income by subtracting sell fee from sell total price
Calculate the profit from the first trade by subtracting initial total cost from sell income
Locate the number of new shares purchased
Locate the current buy price value in the image
Calculate the new buy cost by multiplying new shares by current buy price
Calculate the final net cost by adding new buy cost to initial total cost
